diagnostics.message: google_privileged_access_manager_entitlement.default resolves its privileged_access role_bindings[].role through lookup(local.ctx.custom_roles, ...), so an entitlement can reference a custom role created by google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles in this same module. Nothing currently orders the entitlement after the custom role's creation (its only depends_on entries are the organization IAM bindings, for service-agent permissions). google_org_policy_policy.default already guards this exact context-indirected reference with a depends_on on google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles, so the entitlement should too; otherwise the referenced custom role may not exist yet when the entitlement is created.
